resume.config.title: Resume
resume.config.worlds.tooltip: Takes a screenshot when you leave a singleplayer world and shows it while the world loads again.
resume.config.servers.tooltip: Takes a screenshot when you leave a server and shows it while you join it again.
resume.config.darkness.tooltip: How much the screenshot is darkened so the loading text stays readable.
resume.config.fade_duration.tooltip: How long the screenshot takes to fade into the world once it has loaded. 0 switches right away.
resume.config.screenshots.tooltip: Opens the folder with the screenshots of your worlds and servers. Delete one to get the normal loading screen back.
